property_summary: For any amount, when the owner sends value via sendMoney to a contract counterparty, that counterparty is endowed with a substantial gas budget (it observes gasleft >= 10000 at entry and the delivery succeeds); the mutant's transfer grants only the 2300-gas stipend, so the counterparty sees a tiny gas endowment / the send reverts, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the unchecked call with transfer, which reverts on failure and limits gas, changing failure semantics.
